# AgentSiteOps

> A manual route-selection system for AI-capable solo builders who need one sellable first offer, one landing page route, and one short validation path before building more software or content.

Status: public self-score 52/100; technically launchable; commercially unvalidated until confirmed payment plus usable intake exists.

## What AgentSiteOps Does

- Scores whether a first AI-service offer is ready for a short validation path.
- Provides a browser-local Plan Studio where a visitor can fill in a project plan and get a preliminary route draft before manual intake.
- Selects one route archetype instead of producing a generic idea list.
- Uses confidence bands and a project-route fit matrix before selling a roadmap.
- Exposes the route source map, confidence bands, and project route fit matrix directly on the route selection method page.
- Publishes a route basis report so route patterns, source maps, confidence bands, downgrade rules, and rejection logic are inspectable.
- Provides a local Route Confidence Checker that maps project type, evidence level, proof asset, delivery boundary, and blockers to high, medium, low, or reject confidence bands.
- Publishes answer pages for pre-build offer validation, generic-AI comparison, and stop rules.
- Produces a route file with buyer, trigger, page structure, objections, outreach, and stop rules.
- Uses evidence boundaries before payment, content expansion, higher pricing, or subscription claims.

## What It Does Not Claim

- No guaranteed traffic, rankings, AI citations, revenue, customers, or payback.
- No automated account, dashboard, subscription software, raw event store, user tracking profile, or third-party analytics endpoint.
- Plan Studio drafts are preliminary planning aids, not final Route Files or proof of demand.
- First-party analytics endpoint is aggregate-only: https://agentsiteops.com/api/events/summary?days=2
- No legal, medical, financial, tax, safety, or other regulated advice.
- PayPal clicks, sitemap success, IndexNow success, crawler access, and page existence are not revenue or demand proof.

## Current Validation Rule

The 48-hour exposure sprint must produce at least one valid continuation signal:

- confirmed payment plus usable intake,
- two qualified replies,
- ten sample views plus three source-link clicks,
- or three repeated objections.

If all are missing at the deadline, the project decision is seal_required.
